answer:
The Olympics that featured the **Fuwa** as mascots was the **2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing, China**.

The official motto (slogan) of those games was:

### **"One World, One Dream"**
(In Chinese: **同一个世界 同一个梦想** - *Tóngyīge shìjiè, tóngyīge mèngxiǎng*)

This motto was adopted to reflect universal values and unity across cultures during the Games. The five Fuwa mascots (Beibei, Jingjing, Huahua, Yingying, and Nini) symbolized different elements (olympic ring colors and natural elements like fish, panda, etc.) and together their names formed the welcoming phrase "Welcome to Beijing."
